notes: The doubled בַּבֹּקֶר is treated as one distributive unit rendered every morning, with the alternative rule 22 split named in that unit's note.
Three preposition-plus-suffix pairs are read as fusions (thereon twice, on it once) exactly as the ASV writes them.
The verse is consistent in fusing עַל plus suffix only where the ASV writes one word: עָלֶיהָ → on it is split because two words are written.
